note: BH-9142: the staleremote check does not page a hub backup json whose own result line is PR_CREATED, PR_MERGED or PR_CLOSED with a GitHub pull URL once the json is older than this many days. The record proves the PR exists, so the close-out is no longer a dead staging step. The check costs no ledger read and no gh call; it is counted in the `staleremote: settled <n>` summary line. 0 turns the rule off (those jsons page as before). A non-number or a value over 365 falls back to 7.
